response.justification: The candidate brings genuine high-throughput systems experience (millions of requests/second at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic), strong TypeScript, and current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure work including MCP tooling, which aligns well with the AI-native engineering environment. However, Python — a must-have — is absent from the resume entirely, most deep distributed-systems work was in DLang and is several years old, and there is limited evidence of Staff-level technical strategy, cross-functional stakeholder leadership, or operational/on-call ownership at scale.
strengths: Hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling experience in current role
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of HTTP requests/sec)
Strong TypeScript/Node.js depth plus broad polyglot engineering background
concerns: No Python experience listed despite it being a must-have skill
Little demonstrated technical-strategy or cross-functional stakeholder leadership at Staff scope
Core distributed-systems experience is dated and in a niche language (DLang)
